git.gitignore_content:
# Framework Stata project
# Data files stay out of git. Do-files, settings.do, and documentation are
# committed; data and logs are not.

# Stata data and session files
*.dta
*.log
*.smcl
*.stswp

# Private data, anywhere in the project
**/private/**
**/*_private/**

# Secrets and credentials
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
**/credentials/**
**/secrets/**
*.key
*.pem

# Logs, cache, and scratch work
**/logs/**
**/cache/**
**/scratch/**
**/tmp/**
slurm-*.out

# System files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
*~
*.tmp
*.bak
